reference_roles.role: Muted teal/steel/amber palette, dark outlines and frontal top-down pixel projection
Small prop scale, pixel density and restrained service-room wear

plates.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent source plate to crop into four tiny top-down 2D gameplay floor-prop sprites for an anime pixel survival game. Make a clean 2-by-2 arrangement with four separate objects, one centered in each equal quadrant, generous fully transparent gutters between cells, and ample transparent canvas margin. Keep each object completely within its quadrant with no overlap; do not draw grid lines or cell backgrounds. All are small workshop hand tools lying flat on a floor, seen from directly overhead in a frontal-orthographic 2.5D gameplay projection, with crisp pixel-art silhouettes and chunked clusters that remain distinct when exported at 16–32 px. Top-left: adjustable steel wrench, recognizable open jaw and small adjustment wheel. Top-right: compact claw hammer with weathered brown wooden handle and blue-gray steel head. Bottom-left: screwdriver with a short muted rust-red/teal grip and straight dark steel shaft. Bottom-right: sturdy pliers with two separated muted teal grips and clear pivot joint. Each tool has a different silhouette and material; no duplicates or recolor variants. Palette is restrained industrial teal, steel, worn brown, muted amber/rust, dark outlines; readable highlights, very little surface noise. True transparent background, actual alpha. No floor, tabletop, shadow, scenery, borders, icons, packaging, text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, isometric end faces, perspective skew, gradients, blur, or soft edges. Output one landscape source plate, no separate panels.
